title: Comparison instruction phases
statement: For natural numbers $a,b,f$, a register $r$ among fifteen registers, labels $y,n$, a function $m$ assigning a label to each of three phases, and a phase $j$, define an instruction as follows: at phase $0$, compare register $12$ with $r$, continuing to $y$ if they are equal and to phase $1$ otherwise; at phase $1$, compare register $12$ with register $11$, continuing to $n$ if they are equal and to phase $2$ otherwise; at phase $2$, increment register $12$ and return to phase $0$.
